entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: A multi-region cross-border telehealth platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for EU and US patients while enforcing strict regional data residency and regulatory compliance under GDPR, HIPAA, and EU MDR.
